# apipbx_announcement (Resource)

Plays a recording, then continues to a destination. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `recording_id` (String) Id of an apipbx_recording.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `next_id` (String)
- `next_type` (String) Where the call goes afterwards: extension, ring_group, voicemail, time_condition, ivr, queue, conference, announcement, misc_destination, set_caller_id, paging_group, voicemail_group, disa or hangup.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
